types.name: Progress.ApplicationServer.AdapterTypes

types.name: Progress.Archive.ArchiveInfo
types.summary: This class provides information from a manifest file for a given archive file.

types.name: Progress.Archive.SignaturePolicyIDs
types.summary: This enumeration describes the values returned by the SignaturePolicy property in a Progress.Archive.ArchiveInfo class .

types.name: Progress.Archive.ValidationPolicyIDs
types.summary: This enumeration describes the values returned by the ValidationPolicy property in a Progress.Archive.ArchiveInfo class and indicate the action to take if validation fails.

types.name: Progress.Collections.HashMap
types.summary: Represents a strongly-typed collection of key-value pairs ( map ) backed by a hash table.

types.name: Progress.Collections.HashMapIterator
types.summary: Represents the type of the object returned by the GetIterator() method in a HashMap<K,V> object, allowing traversal of the elements in the hash map.

types.name: Progress.Collections.ICollection
types.summary: The Progress.Collections.ICollection<T> interface is common to all collections and defines properties and methods to manipulate generic collections.

types.name: Progress.Collections.IComparable
types.summary: The Progress.Collections.IComparable<T> interface imposes an ordering on the objects of the class that implements it.

types.name: Progress.Collections.IComparer
types.summary: The Progress.Collections.IComparer<T> interface provides a method to support the comparison of objects for equality.

types.name: Progress.Collections.IEqualityComparer
types.summary: The Progress.Collections.IEqualityComparer<T> interface provides an alternate implementation of HashCode() and Equals() to the map collection.

types.name: Progress.Collections.IHashable
types.summary: Progress.Collections.IHashable is an interface which allows objects to be used as keys.

types.name: Progress.Collections.IIterable
types.summary: Progress.Collections.IIterable<T> interface is the root interface for all the collections classes.

types.name: Progress.Collections.IIterator
types.summary: The Progress.Collections.IIterator<T> interface provides common functionality for classes to traverse a collection of objects.

types.name: Progress.Collections.IList
types.summary: Defines the model for a list-based collection.

types.name: Progress.Collections.IMap
types.summary: Progress.Collections.IMap<K,V> is the root interface for the HashMap collection class.

types.name: Progress.Collections.ISet
types.summary: Progress.Collections.ISet<T> is the root interface for all set collection classes.

types.name: Progress.Collections.KeySet
types.summary: This class is used by the Keys property of Progress.Collections.HashMap<K,V> class to return a set containing all the keys in the HashMap instance.

types.name: Progress.Collections.KeySetIterator
types.summary: Represents the type of the object returned by the GetIterator( ) method (Collections) in a Progress.Collections.KeySet<K> class .

types.name: Progress.Collections.KeyValuePair
types.summary: Progress.Collections.KeyValuePair<K,V> is a class that holds a key-value pair for a Map collection.

types.name: Progress.Collections.List
types.summary: Represents a strongly-typed list of objects that can be accessed by index.

types.name: Progress.Collections.ListIterator
types.summary: The Progress.Collections.ListIterator <T> class represents the type of object returned by the GetIterator() method on a List<T> class and allows the traversal of elements in the list.

types.name: Progress.Collections.SortedSet
types.summary: Represents a strongly-typed collection of unique objects that is maintained in sorted order.

types.name: Progress.Collections.SortedSetIterator
types.summary: Represents the type of the object returned by the GetIterator() method on a SortedSet<T> class, allowing the traversal of elements in the sorted set.

types.name: Progress.Database.TempTableInfo

types.name: Progress.Json.ObjectModel.JsonDataType

types.name: Progress.Lang.MessagingError
types.summary: The Progress.Lang.MessagingError class provides the functionality to retrieve error information when an error occurs in the underlying third-party messaging system.

types.name: Progress.Lang.MessagingErrorAbort
types.summary: The AVM throws this error on a method when an error occurs such that the current transaction must be aborted.

types.name: Progress.Lang.MessagingErrorFatal
types.summary: The AVM throws this error on a method when a fatal error occurs that is not recoverable.

types.name: Progress.Lang.MessagingErrorRetriable
types.summary: The AVM throws this error on a method when a retriable error occurs.

types.name: Progress.Lang.Object
types.summary: Progress.Lang.Object provides a common set of properties and methods that all classes inherit.

types.name: Progress.Lang.OERequestInfo

types.name: Progress.Lang.OEVersionInfo

types.name: Progress.Lang.ParameterList
types.summary: Stores the parameter values for a specific method or constructor call.

types.name: Progress.Lang.SoapFaultError

types.name: Progress.Lang.StopError
types.summary: When the AVM encounters certain unexpected error conditions, it throws an instance of the Progress.Lang.StopError class containing messages associated with the originating error, and raises the STOP condition.

types.name: Progress.Lang.SysError
types.summary: When an ABL statement raises the error condition, the AVM throws an error.

types.name: Progress.Lang.UserInterrupt
types.summary: The AVM throws an instance of the Progress.Lang.UserInterrupt class and raises the STOP condition when the AVM detects that the user has pressed the STOP key (usually mapped to CTRL + C on Unix/Linux or CTRL + Break in Windows).

types.name: Progress.Profiler.MemoryProfiler
